title: 第7章 何其伟大的觉悟第8章 贤者状态谁都有
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
擂台之上，叶云眼中精光一闪，手指也扣动金灵弩的扳机。
“接招吧！”
刹那之间，一缕缕金色的玄气，飞速向着弩身汇聚，最终化作一道破空的金色光矢轰然射出！
这光矢之上蕴含的锐利气息，令刚刚还傲气十足的雪兰，脸色陡然一变。
“不好！”
金色光矢的速度之快，以她的实力根本无力闪避，只能急忙将一枚青色水晶祭出。
“青木结界！”
一根根粗壮的青色藤蔓，迅速从地面窜出，在其面前编制成一面巨大的木之结界。
原本凡阶中品法宝青木盾，是堂姐交予她的防御底牌。
她怎么也没想到，居然一上来就被逼着用了出来。
可更让她难以置信，是随后的金色光矢，竟将前方的青木结界直接轰碎！
“这怎么可能？！”
雪兰美眸微震。
下一秒，面前结界爆裂产生的余波，直接将她震得连连后退。
一时之间，众人都瞪大了眼睛。
“不是，叶云一击把雪兰给打退了？”
“关键是他哪来这么厉害的法宝？”
“不止如此，看他释放出的玄气，好像已达到凝气五重了啊！”
“……”
周围之人无不惊愕，这哪里还是他们印象中的叶云？

无论是那凝气五重的修为，还是堪比凡阶上品的法宝，都透露着不可思议。
台上的雪兰虽然也意识到不对，可即使如此，她还是不信邪，对叶云咬牙切齿道。
“我怎么可能，输给你一个废柴杂役！”
在雪兰的愤怒声中，她手中亮起一抹蓝光，那赫然是一把尺子。
随着雪兰双手掐诀，蓝色的尺子骤然飞起，并一分为百，如雨点般向前方的叶云倾泻而去。
“千化尺，去！”
这是堂姐给她的另一件凡阶中品法宝，眼下也只能靠它来打开局势了。
只要能凭着法宝压制叶云，她就能趁机出手将优势扩大，直至将他给淘汰。
可面对这宣泄而来的攻击，叶云却是主动迎上，同时向前伸出一只手。
只见一面青金色的盾牌，迅速在其前方展开，并将所有落下的蓝色光尺抵消，自身却始终纹丝不动。
叶云持着盾牌，硬是顶着雪兰法宝攻击，迅速拉近着与她的距离。
“你……你不要过来！”
雪兰眼看攻击无效，脸上立刻慌了，连连后退想要拉开与叶云的距离。
就在同时，叶云耳边传来一道急促的女声。
content_en:
On the stage, Ye Yun's eyes flashed, and his finger pulled the trigger of the Golden Spirit Crossbow.
"Take the move!"
In an instant, wisps of golden profound energy quickly gathered towards the crossbow body, and finally turned into a golden light arrow that broke through the air and shot out!
The sharp aura contained in this light arrow made Xue Lan, who was still so arrogant just now, suddenly change her expression.
"Not good!"
The speed of the golden light arrow was so fast that she was unable to dodge it due to her strength, so she could only quickly throw out a cyan crystal.
"Aoki Barrier!"
Thick green vines quickly sprang out from the ground, forming a huge wooden barrier in front of it.
Originally, the Aoki Shield, a middle-grade mortal magic weapon, was a defensive trump card given to her by her cousin.
She never expected that she would be forced to use it as soon as she came up.
But what made her even more unbelievable was that the golden light arrow that followed directly shattered the Aoki barrier in front of her!
"How is this possible?!"
Xuelan's beautiful eyes trembled slightly.
The next second, the aftermath of the explosion of the barrier in front of her directly shook her back.
For a moment, everyone's eyes widened.
"No, Ye Yun knocked Xuelan back with one blow?"
"The key is where did he get such a powerful magic weapon?"
"More than that, the profound energy he released seems to have reached the fifth level of Qi Condensation!"
"..."
Everyone around was shocked. How could this be the same Ye Yun they remembered?
Whether it was the cultivation of the fifth level of Qi Condensation or the magic weapon that was comparable to the top-grade mortals, they were both incredible.
Although Xuelan on the stage also realized that something was wrong, even so, she still did not believe in evil and gritted her teeth at Ye Yun.
"How could I possibly lose to you, a useless handyman!"
Amidst Xuelan's angry voice, a blue light lit up in her hand, which was a ruler.
As Xuelan made the secret with her hands, the blue ruler suddenly flew up and divided into a hundred, pouring like raindrops towards Ye Yun in front of her.
"Qianhua Chi, go!"
This is another mid-grade mortal magic weapon given to her by her cousin, and now she can only rely on it to open up the situation.
As long as she can suppress Ye Yun with her magic weapon, she can take the opportunity to expand her advantage until he is eliminated.
But in the face of this cathartic attack, Ye Yun took the initiative to meet it, and at the same time stretched out a hand forward.
I saw a blue-gold shield that quickly unfolded in front of it and offset all the falling blue light rulers, but it itself remained motionless.
Ye Yun held a shield and attacked with Xuelan's magic weapon, quickly closing the distance with her.
"You...don't come over!"
Seeing that the attack was ineffective, Xuelan immediately panicked and stepped back in an attempt to distance herself from Ye Yun.
At the same time, a hurried female voice came from Ye Yun's ear.
